extraction: Local Agent Ollama Models: Ollama is only implemented inference runtime. Model picker driven by Ollama live inventory (installed local weights, available Ollama Cloud aliases). Groups by execution location: Local (weights on this instance), Cloud (aliases for manual selection, require exact conversation consent under local-only policy), Remote (models from non-Cloud remote host, visible but not selectable). Rows can be unavailable due to runtime capability, context metadata, privacy policy, local memory guard. Automatic routing and pins: choosing verified local model pins it across restarts. /model auto clears saved choice. Startup --model flag or agent-profile model takes precedence. Cloud consent limited to current conversation, never restored implicitly.
